newsitem.title: UK: Fairway sees year pretax below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Fairway sees year pretax below expectations.

text.p: Fairway Group Plc said on Tuesday it expected its pretax profits for the year to be higher than last year's but significantly below current market expectations.

Fairway, which provides print facilities management for companies, also said it expected its group operating profits during the second half to be substantially below those in the first six months of the year after non-recurring costs.
The company said it would have an additional 230,000 stg in development costs on top of the 425,000 stg it reported in its interim statement.
Fairway reported pretax profits of 1.8 million stg in the first half, compared to 1.7 million stg in the year-ago period.
Operating profits from continuing operations were 2.0 million stg for the first six months against 1.9 million stg.
